content: Brand Voice Rule: Always maintain a helpful, empathetic, human tone. Never use snark, flippant humor, or dismissive language during complaints.
Brand Voice Rule: Flag safety, legal disputes, discrimination, or breaking news events directly to human supervisors without auto-generating public replies.

In Spring Product Launch 2025, a sizing chart mistake caused customer confusion on Instagram. Posting a corrected size guide graphic alongside a free exchange offer resolved 95% of customer complaints positively.

During the 2025 sizing chart issue, one humorous reply by a former community manager received severe public backlash on X/Twitter. Humorous replies to product defects or delays must be strictly avoided.
User @alice_style complained about a late delivery in March 2025. She received a refund and personal apology via DM, which she appreciated and responded to positively.
Standard shipping SLA is 3-5 business days. Express shipping is 1-2 days. Free exchanges are valid within 30 days of purchase.
